thread:
Jordan (AE): Hey team — customer wants SIG questionnaire evidence for the deal (LargeFinCorp). Starting with the encryption section. Can we collect docs for 'encryption at rest', 'KMS key management', and 'audit logs'? Need to hand to their vendor risk team by EOD tomorrow.
Aisha Khan: I can take primary on controls/evidence. Quick checklist: SOC2 report (relevant sections), KMS key policy, data flow diagram showing where keys are used, and a log retention statement.
Priya Mehta: Also they asked if customer-managed keys (BYOK) are supported for Private deployments — flag that separately.
Tom Garcia: For hosted API / Redwood control plane we use AWS KMS with a dedicated key per tenant group (logical). Evidence lives in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Sec/pages/12938/SIG+evidence (private link). I can drop the architecture diagram there.
Sam Li: For the immediate ask, here's a snippet to show key metadata for the prod key (they asked for key rotation policy and creation date):
```
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood-prod --region us-west-2
# returns KeyId, CreationDate, Enabled, KeyState, Description
```
Aisha Khan: Good — include a copy of the key policy (redact ARNs where needed). Also prepare a short plain-English statement: "All customer data at rest in hosted Redwood is encrypted using AES-256; keys are stored and managed in AWS KMS with automatic rotation and RBAC restricted to the Redwood key admin role."
Jordan (AE): LargeFinCorp specifically wants proof of rotation schedule and who can access key material. They also want confirmation that backups are encrypted with the same KMS keys.
Tom Garcia: Rotation: we rotate CMKs every 365 days. Backup encryption: EBS snapshots + S3 snapshots are encrypted with the CMK used by the service; I'll paste the snapshot encryption policy in Confluence.
Priya Mehta: On BYOK: for Private deployments, customers can provide HSM-backed keys via their KMS/CloudHSM — we document it in the Private deployment security guide (link in Confluence). Note: sales/legal will need an addendum for BYOK SLAs.
Aisha Khan: For logs: we retain KMS, CloudTrail, and application logs for 365 days by default. I'll attach the retention policy and sample CloudTrail export (redacted).
Sam Li: Uploaded sample CloudTrail export to the evidence bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/clients/largefincorp/sig/encryption/ (access via signed link). evidence-bot: Uploaded file largefincorp_cloudtrail_sample_20240401.json (access expires in 7 days).
evidence-bot: File uploaded: https://files.redwood.com/evidence/largefincorp_cloudtrail_sample_20240401.json
Aisha Khan: For the SIG question-by-question doc I'll map each SIG question to a bullet of evidence: 1) Encryption at rest -> SOC2 section 6 + KMS policy + architecture diagram. 2) Key rotation -> KMS rotation schedule + automation runbook. 3) BYOK -> Private deploy docs + legal addendum note. 4) Access controls -> IAM roles + least-privilege matrix. I'll assemble and post a zip in the sales portal.
Jordan (AE): Perfect. Can you also include a short cover email template I can send to the customer's risk team summarizing the attachments?
Priya Mehta: I'll draft a 3-bullet cover email: what is included, contact for follow-ups (security@redwood.com), and link to SOC2. Keep it simple.
Tom Garcia: One more technical item they sometimes ask: show the KMS key alias and the KMS key rotation MTTR/runbook snippet. I'll paste the exact CLI output if you want.
Sam Li: CLI sample added to Confluence page under Evidence -> KMS -> cli_examples.txt.
Aisha Khan: I'll mark the thread as 'evidence-in-progress' and upload the final zip by 17:00 PST. If anyone has redaction concerns ping me.
Jordan (AE): Thanks all — i'll update the CR in the deal and ping LargeFinCorp after you upload. :thumbsup:
Aisha Khan: Uploaded final zip to sales portal: https://sales.redwood.com/evidence/largefincorp_sig_encryption.zip (password-protected). Closing this thread after follow-up notes are added.
Jordan (AE): Received — will send to their vendor risk.
